## Starter commands {#commands}

```bash
# Cluster status
sinfo
squeue -u $USER

# Submit and cancel
sbatch job.slurm
scancel <jobid>

# Interactive shell
srun --partition=interactive --time=01:00:00 --mem=4G --cpus-per-task=2 --pty bash -i

# Accounting
sacct -j <jobid> --format=JobID,State,Elapsed,MaxRSS,ReqMem,AllocCPUS
seff <jobid>
```

## Slurm environment variables {#variables}

| Variable | Meaning |
|:----------|:-------------------------------|
| `$SLURM_JOB_ID` | Numeric job ID. |
| `$SLURM_JOB_NAME` | Job name from `--job-name`. |
| `$SLURMD_NODENAME` | Node running the job. |
| `$SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK` | Number of CPU cores requested with `--cpus-per-task`. |
| `$SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID` | Current array task index. Only set for job arrays. |
| `$SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR` | Directory from which the job was submitted. |

## Minimal script skeleton {#skeleton}

```{.bash filename="job.slurm"}
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --job-name=<name>
#SBATCH --output=logs/%x-%j.out
#SBATCH --error=logs/%x-%j.err
#SBATCH --time=HH:MM:SS
#SBATCH --mem=4G
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1
#SBATCH --partition=general

set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p logs

source ~/miniforge3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate <env-name>

# Your command here
python script.py
```
